recognize_zh: 四格胸水抹片中，大量紅血球背景（血性胸水）裡散布大型漿細胞樣細胞：核偏位、細胞質深嗜鹼性並有核旁淡染區（hof）與細小空泡，部分細胞核大、染色質較細、體積明顯大於成熟漿細胞，右下格另見雙核／核分裂樣細胞；骨髓瘤病史加上這些不成熟漿母細胞，支持骨髓瘤性（plasmablastic）胸水。
features: Composite of four fields from a bloody pleural effusion smear with dense red cell background
Large plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hof
Immature (plasmablastic) features: large nuclei with relatively fine/dispersed chromatin, high N:C ratio in some cells; nucleoli not well resolved at this resolution
Small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles along the cell margins in several cells
Pleomorphism with a binucleate/multilobated cell and a possible mitotic figure (lower right panel); scattered small lymphocytes and a neutrophil
describe_en: Cytospin/smear of pleural fluid shows a markedly bloody background with numerous atypical plasma cells, illustrated in four fields. The cells are large, with eccentric nuclei, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, perinuclear hofs and fine peripheral vacuoles; many have relatively dispersed chromatin and a high N:C ratio, consistent with plasmablastic morphology. Pleomorphic forms, a binucleate cell and a probable mitotic figure are present, whereas mesothelial cells and reactive inflammatory cells are sparse; nucleoli are not well resolved at this image resolution. In a patient with a history of multiple myeloma, and with flow cytometric confirmation of a clonal plasma cell population, findings are consistent with myelomatous (plasmablastic) pleural effusion.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells have central round nuclei, dense two-tone cytoplasm with a peripheral lacy brush border and form 'windows' between cells, lacking the eccentric nucleus and perinuclear hof of plasma cells; calretinin/CD138 separate them.

Plasmablastic lymphoma has similar cytology but usually arises in HIV/immunosuppressed patients without a myeloma history, lacks serum paraprotein-related bone disease and is often EBER-positive and MYC-rearranged.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis in effusion (e.g., tuberculosis, rheumatoid pleuritis)
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are small, mature and polytypic, mixed with lymphocytes, not large pleomorphic plasmablasts with mitoses and light-chain restriction.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive three-dimensional clusters with nuclear molding and keratin positivity, whereas myeloma cells are discohesive, CD138-positive and light-chain restricted.
